name: Beraka
title: Warrior from the Tribe of Benjamin
summary: Beraka was one of the skilled warriors from the tribe of Benjamin who joined David in Ziklag while he was fleeing from King Saul. His name means 'blessing' in Hebrew. He was among the brave men who could use both their right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow.

keyEvents.title: Joined David in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Beraka was among the Benjaminite warriors who left Saul and joined David while he was staying in Ziklag. These men were skilled with weapons and could use both hands.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among David's Heroes
keyEvents.description: Beraka is named as one of the prominent warriors who came to David. He is listed alongside other well-known Benjaminites such as Ahiezer and Joash.

keyEvents.title: Support for David before he became king
keyEvents.description: Beraka's switch to David's side was part of a broader movement in which warriors from various tribes left Saul to support David's claim to the throne.

keyEvents.title: David's forces grow
keyEvents.description: The allegiance of Benjaminites like Beraka showed that God's plan for David's kingdom was being fulfilled, as even Saul's own tribal relatives abandoned him.
